# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── Dockerfile
├── .dockerignore
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── src/
    └── index.ts
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# =============================================================================
# Stage 1: Dependencies
# Install ALL dependencies (including devDependencies) needed for building
# =============================================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS dependencies

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Install dumb-init for proper signal handling in containers
# Use --no-cache to avoid storing the apk index
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# Copy package files first to leverage Docker layer caching
# Layers are only rebuilt when these files change
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install all dependencies including devDependencies
# --frozen-lockfile ensures reproducible builds
# --prefer-offline uses cached packages when available
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# =============================================================================
# Stage 2: Builder
# Compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# =============================================================================
FROM dependencies AS builder

# Copy TypeScript source files and config
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/

# Compile TypeScript
# Output goes to /app/dist (as configured in tsconfig.json)
RUN npm run build

# Prune devDependencies after build
# This creates a clean node_modules with only production deps
RUN npm prune --production

# =============================================================================
# Stage 3: Production
# Minimal final image with only what's needed to run the app
# =============================================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS production

# Set NODE_ENV to production
# This affects behavior of many npm packages (e.g., Express)
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Create a non-root user for security
# -S: system user, -G: add to group, -H: no home directory
RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy dumb-init from the dependencies stage
COPY --from=dependencies /usr/bin/dumb-init /usr/bin/dumb-init

# Copy pruned node_modules from builder stage
# Only production dependencies are included
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy compiled JavaScript from builder stage
# Only the dist/ folder is needed, NOT the TypeScript source
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist

# Copy package.json for runtime metadata (version, name, etc.)
COPY package.json ./

# Change ownership of app files to non-root user
RUN chown -R appuser:appgroup /app

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Expose the application port
EXPOSE 3000

# Health check to verify the container is running correctly
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', (r) => { process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1) })" \
    || exit 1

# Use dumb-init as PID 1 to handle signals properly
# This prevents zombie processes and ensures graceful shutdown
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]

# Start the application
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## .dockerignore

```dockerignore
# Version control
.git
.gitignore

# Dependencies (will be installed fresh in Docker)
node_modules

# TypeScript source (only dist/ goes to production)
src

# Build output (rebuilt in Docker)
dist

# Environment files (use Docker secrets or env vars instead)
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# Development config files
.eslintrc*
.prettierrc*
jest.config*
*.test.ts
*.spec.ts

# Documentation
README.md
CHANGELOG.md
docs/

# Docker files themselves
Dockerfile*
docker-compose*
.dockerignore

# OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# IDE files
.vscode
.idea
*.swp
*.swo

# Logs
logs/
*.log
npm-debug.log*

# Coverage reports
coverage/
.nyc_output/
```

## Supporting Configuration Files

### tsconfig.json
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": false,
    "sourceMap": false,
    "removeComments": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
}
```

### package.json
```json
{
  "name": "my-typescript-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Node.js TypeScript application",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts",
    "lint": "eslint src/**/*.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2",
    "ts-node-dev": "^2.0.0"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  }
}
```

### src/index.ts (Example Application)
```typescript
import express, { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Middleware
app.use(express.json());

// Health check endpoint (used by Docker HEALTHCHECK)
app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    uptime: process.uptime(),
  });
});

// Example route
app.get('/', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Hello from TypeScript!' });
});

// Global error handler
app.use((err: Error, _req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction) => {
  console.error(err.stack);
  res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal Server Error' });
});

// Graceful shutdown handling
const server = app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});

process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
  console.log('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully...');
  server.close(() => {
    console.log('Server closed');
    process.exit(0);
  });
});

export default app;
```

## Build and Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-typescript-app:latest .

# Build with specific target stage (useful for debugging)
docker build --target builder -t my-typescript-app:debug .

# Run the container
docker run -d \
  --name my-app \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -e NODE_ENV=production \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  my-typescript-app:latest

# Check image size comparison
docker images my-typescript-app

# Inspect layers
docker history my-typescript-app:latest

# View logs
docker logs -f my-app

# Check health status
docker inspect --format='{{.State.Health.Status}}' my-app
```

## Image Size Comparison

| Approach | Base Image | Approximate Size |
|---|---|---|
| Single stage (node:20) | Full Debian | ~1.2 GB |
| Single stage (node:20-alpine) | Alpine | ~400 MB |
| **Multi-stage (this Dockerfile)** | **Alpine** | **~150 MB** |
| Distroless (advanced) | Distroless | ~120 MB |

## Key Optimizations Explained

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    STAGE 1: dependencies                     │
│  • Alpine base (smaller than Debian/Ubuntu)                  │
│  • npm ci (faster, reproducible, uses lockfile)              │
│  • Installs ALL deps (dev + prod) for building               │
└─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
                      │ COPY only what's needed
┌─────────────────────▼───────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    STAGE 2: builder                          │
│  • Compiles TypeScript → JavaScript                          │
│  • Prunes devDependencies (removes ~60-70% of node_modules)  │
│  • Source maps disabled (smaller output)                     │
└─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┘
                      │ COPY only dist/ + pruned node_modules
┌─────────────────────▼───────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    STAGE 3: production                       │
│  • Fresh Alpine base (no build tools)                        │
│  • No TypeScript source files                                │
│  • No devDependencies                                        │
│  • Non-root user (security)                                  │
│  • dumb-init (proper PID 1 handling)                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

The multi-stage build ensures the final image contains **only the compiled JavaScript, production dependencies, and the minimal Alpine runtime** — nothing else.
